संशोधयति { सं- शुध् } saMzodhayati { saM- zudh } verb caus. correct उक्तं एव वदति सः uktaM eva vadati saH sent. He has been repeating the same thing. न, सः गृहे न अस्ति. na, saH gRhe na asti. sent. No, he is not at home. सः वृद्धः इव भाति saH vRddhaH iva bhAti sent. He looks aged. सः तव शिक्षकः किं? saH tava zikSakaH kiM? sent. Is he your teacher? सः विरामं स्वीकृतवान् saH virAmaM svIkRtavAn sent. He is on leave.
